roleEssence: As CS Manager for North America, Anat owns a portfolio of enterprise accounts and leads a small pod of Customer Success Managers, coaching them through pipeline reviews and career growth. Her day-to-day depends heavily on Salesforce data for forecasting NRR and churn, and on close coordination with Sales on renewals/expansion and Product on customer feedback. Expertise in this role looks like balancing hands-on account ownership with people leadership - accountable for her own book and for her team's outcomes.

onboardingNeeds.title: Sit in on a live QBR or account review
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence names coaching CSMs through QBR prep as central to the role - seeing a real QBR run before she's the one coaching others through one is the fastest way to learn what 'good' actually looks like here. This is a genuine shadow-first case, not a default: her accounts and CSMs already have an existing cadence she's stepping into, unlike a role built from scratch.
